patches_modified.name: Bypass Google Sign-In
patches_modified.description: Bypasses SHA-1 check by using embedded WebView OAuth for Google Sign-In.

patches_modified.name: Bypass license check
patches_modified.description: Bypasses PairIP license verification.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Disables Firebase Crashlytics, Sessions, and Analytics.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium features
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all premium capabilities.

patches_added.name: Use Bluetooth Microphone
patches_added.description:
啟用 語音輸入 -> 使用藍芽麥克風
Enable Voice typing -> Use Bluetooth microphone.

patches_added.name: Movie Paradise - GmsCore support (microG login)
patches_added.description: Routes Google Play Services through microG (MicroG-RE) so Google sign-in works without stock Play Services.

patches_modified.name: Remove Wildberries ads
patches_modified.description: Removes Wildberries home banners, grid banners, profile banners, promo headers, product recommendations, and lottery popups.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ozon ads
patches_modified.description: Removes Ozon ad widgets, banner carousels, video ads, and PDP promo blocks.

patches_added.name: Wide search bar
patches_added.description: Adds a wide search bar to the top of the home and subscription feed.

patches_modified.name: Navigation bar
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide and change the bottom navigation bar (such as the Shorts button)  and the upper navigation toolbar.

patches_added.name: Disable email confirmation dialog
patches_added.description: Immediately closes the "confirm your email" modal (and similar ones: connect Google, etc.) if enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_added.name: Download board
patches_added.description: Adds an option to the board's "…" menu to bulk download images and videos from already loaded pins. Streaming-only videos are reported and skipped.

patches_added.name: Hide Create nav button
patches_added.description: Hooks the '+' (create Pin) navigation bar button: hidden if enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_added.name: Hide Notifications nav button
patches_added.description: Hooks the notifications button: hidden if enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_added.name: Hide Search nav button
patches_added.description: Hooks the search button: hidden if enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_added.name: Hide search history
patches_added.description: Hides the "Recent searches" section both on the search screen and in the carousel below the search bar. It does not prevent Pinterest from logging searches (server-side), but stops them from being shown anywhere in the app.

patches_added.name: Morphe settings entry
patches_added.description: Adds the "Morphe" item to the Account Settings list to open the toggle screen.

patches_added.name: Morphe settings screen (label)
patches_added.description: Renames the reused string resource for the "Morphe" entry in Settings, across all languages.

patches_added.name: Morphe settings screen (manifest)
patches_added.description: Registers the Morphe settings Activity in the manifest, with an intent-filter for the morphe:// scheme.

patches_modified.name: Copy direct link
patches_modified.description: Adds a 'Copy direct link' option to the pin menu to copy a link under the direct CDN media format instead of the standard Pinterest web link.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored (promoted) pins from the home feed and from search/related/board feeds.

patches_modified.name: Download video
patches_modified.description: Adds a 'Download video' option to the pin menu for video pins, saving the clip to the Downloads folder.

patches_modified.name: Neutralize advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Returns an empty Google Advertising ID and forces ‘limit ad tracking’, disabling ad tracking without causing the app to crash.

patches_modified.name: Set pin as wallpaper
patches_modified.description: It adds the ‘Set as wallpaper’ option to the pin menu, which downloads uses the image and sets it as the device’s wallpaper.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all premium features.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all premium features.

patches_modified.name: Disable Mine redesign
patches_modified.description: Reverts the Mine screen to the classic layout, disabling the redesigned V2/V3 interface.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Removes all advertisements from the app.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Disables VK-specific analytics.

patches_modified.name: Disable background scan
patches_modified.description: Disables the periodic Kaspersky background device scan.

patches_modified.name: Disable gaming profile
patches_modified.description: Removes the Game Profile section from the Mine screen, including the button and the usage statistics screen.

patches_modified.name: Skip update auth
patches_modified.description: Removes the login requirement when updating apps.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Disables PulseSDK analytics.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks premium features and removes ads.

patches_added.name: Hide Events button
patches_added.description: Removes the "Events" row from a chat room's slide-out menu. (Events is a separate feature from LINE Calendar — it opens a server-hosted page.)

patches_added.name: Hide LINE GIFT button
patches_added.description: Removes the LINE GIFT tile from a chat room's + attach menu.

patches_added.name: Hide Transfer button
patches_added.description: Removes the Transfer (LINE Pay) tile from a chat room's + attach menu.

patches_added.name: Hide attach menu extra tools
patches_added.description: Removes all the server-provided extra tools from a chat room's + attach menu (Poll, Reservation, Schedule, Ladder shuffle, and any others). The built-in tiles (camera, gallery, files, contact, etc.) are unaffected.

patches_added.name: Hide calendar buttons
patches_added.description: Removes every LINE Calendar button inside the messenger: the one in the Chats-tab header, and the four inside a chat room — the top toolbar, the + attach menu, the slide-out chat menu, and the message long-press menu.

patches_removed.name: Hide calendar button
patches_removed.description: Removes the calendar button from the top of the Chats tab header.
